headline: Chile Finance Minister caps truckers agreement fiscal cost at $700 million
summary: Chilean Finance Minister Quiroz limited the total fiscal cost of the government's agreement with truckers to $700 million while forecasting a potential October drop in the Imacec economic activity index.
why: Fiscal commitments and transport policy directly impact government budget balances and national economic activity indicators in Chile.

impacts.name: Chile
impacts.why: Fiscal expenditure limits and slowing Imacec output reflect macroeconomic headwinds.
